paragraphs.text: Aldon's Castle stood in the Western Domains .
The caste was ruled by Aldon and his family during the time between the casting of the World Spell and Year One of the Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad according to a Dominarian fable.
The wizard Dreygar overtook the castle and sent Aldon into hiding. Aldon, with the aid of his Serra Angels , vampire , bog wraith , and frozen shade , retook the castle.
More than 1500 years have passed since these events; it is unknown if the castle still stands.
